method: Sequential fresh workers; first use then warm end-to-end samples. Imports excluded from call timings but included in worker budget. Existing disk caches retained; first use is not an empty-cache measurement. Input conversion and preprocessing included. No dominance prefilter, fastmath, parallelism, or disabled compression.
compression_schedule: compiled and Chan d/3 adaptive defaults; forced cases use interval 2, factor 0; Numerical Python retains its original local block schedule
